newsitem.title: USA: MEDIQ to buy Universal for $135 mln.
newsitem.headline: MEDIQ to buy Universal for $135 mln.

text.p: MEDIQ Inc said Tuesday it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Universal Hospital Services Inc for $17.50 per share of Universal stock.
Including the assumption of debt, the total purchase price is about $138 million, it said.

MEDIQ said that the transaction would be immediately accretive to MEDIQ's earnings while reducing costs through synergies. The transaction is structured as a cash merger that is expected to close in late March or early April subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
MEDIQ stated that it would fund the transaction with available cash and its existing credit agreement, agented by Banque Nationale de Paris and NationsBank.
MEDIQ operates a critical care and life support medical equipment rental business in the U.S. For the fiscal year ended September 30, MEDIQ had revenues of $136 million.

Universal provides movable medical equipment to hospitals and alternate care providers principally through pay-per-use equipment management programs. For the 12 months ended September 30, Universal had revenues of more than $60 million, pro forma for a recent acquisition.
